Writing J=|a||b|^2 rho^2 sigma^2 tau^2, newest partner r51 gives the leverage-free essential density bound ||p_Q||_infinity<=12 J^(-1/3).
Whole-copy convolution and the scalar independent-copy identity give E|Q-Q'|^(-1/2)<=4sqrt(6)J^(-1/6) and weighted time <=8sqrt(3pi)J^(-1/6), with no coordinatewise sum/difference independence.
If the three-dimensional physical range leverage is <=1/2, pinned Theorem F gives the same density constant 12J^(-1/3) and stronger weighted time <=(48/5)sqrt(pi)J^(-1/6).

scope_limits: The determinant-dual theorem applies to a specific product-valid same-bank square-hyperbola packet; it is not yet an exhaustive extraction theorem from arbitrary A.
The leverage-free partner endpoint gives essential boundedness but does not by itself establish continuity.
No universal positive conditional projection-density moment is claimed; the live correction forbids it.
The unrestricted QFORM density conjecture remains open and unrestricted continuity remains open.
first_unpaid_implication: From every survivor of the already-paid exterior/volume/grouped branches, product-preservingly extract a same-bank square-hyperbola packet with J bounded below, or route to another aggregate receiver; do not make positive conditional projection-density moments an intermediate gate.
